_note: Platform aspect-ratio presets for Cappytool No.2, live-verified from official help-center docs on 2026-08-22. Each entry cites a primary official source URL that was actually fetched. Where the official doc gives an exact pixel size it is used verbatim; otherwise the ratio is taken from the official doc and the pixel size is the well-known standard for that ratio, noted as 'px from standard'. Ratios are restricted to the preset set: 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9, 2:3, 1.91:1, 21:9. Only Reddit (feed post) could not be confirmed from an official number and is flagged unverified.

image.note: X keeps single images uncropped between 2:1 and 1:1, so 16:9 is the safe default; X help center publishes no exact in-stream image px, so 1200x675 is the standard size (px from standard, ratio from official crop behavior).

video.note: X Media Studio recommends 1280x720 for landscape video (square 720x720 also supported); 16:9 is the standard upload.

image.note: Instagram keeps photos at original resolution when the aspect ratio is 1.91:1 to 3:4 (width up to 1080px); 4:5 portrait (1080x1350) is the recommended feed default. px from standard, ratio from official doc.

video.note: Feed video supports the same 1.91:1 to 3:4 window; 4:5 portrait (1080x1350) is the recommended default. px from standard, ratio from official doc.

image.note: Reels support 1.91:1 to 9:16 at minimum 720p; Stories/Reels are full-screen 9:16 (1080x1920 standard, px from standard, ratio from official doc).

video.note: Reels support 1.91:1 to 9:16; 9:16 vertical (1080x1920) is the standard full-screen format. px from standard, ratio from official doc.

image.note: Pinterest recommends a 2:3 aspect ratio, or 1000 x 1500 pixels; Pins taller than 2:3 may be cut off in feeds (exact px from official doc).

video.note: Pin videos follow the same 2:3 vertical guidance; Pinterest recommends square (1:1) or vertical (2:3, 4:5, 9:16). px 1000x1500 from standard, ratio from official doc.

image.note: YouTube recommends 16:9 custom thumbnails; 1280x720 is the minimum HD size (thumbnails below 720p are downscaled). px from standard, ratio from official doc.

video.note: YouTube video frame is 16:9; 1920x1080 is the standard full-HD upload.

image.note: YouTube recommends the banner image be at least 2560x1440 px (16:9); safe area is 1546x423 centered. Exact px from official doc.

video.note: Same channel-art asset as the banner (2560x1440, 16:9). Exact px from official doc.

image.note: Facebook's aspect-ratio help confirms 1080x1350 = 4:5; feed posts also accept 1:1 and 1.91:1 link previews (1200x630). px from standard, ratio from official doc.

video.note: Feed video is 16:9; 1280x720 is the standard upload size.

image.note: Facebook recommends 851x315 for the fastest-loading Page cover (desktop is 16:9 full bleed; mobile is 2.4:1). Exact px from official doc.

video.note: Cover video uses the same 851x315 (16:9 desktop) area as the cover photo. Exact px from official doc.

image.note: LinkedIn recommends a 1.91:1 ratio (1200x627) for shared link/article previews; uploaded photos support 4:5 portrait too. Exact px from official doc.

video.note: Feed video is 16:9; 1280x720 is the standard upload size.

image.note: TikTok requires uploaded videos be 720x1280 or higher (9:16); in-feed video/image is vertical 9:16 (1080x1920 standard).

video.note: TikTok requires uploaded videos be 720x1280 resolution or higher (9:16); 1080x1920 is the standard full-screen upload. Ratio/px floor from official doc.

image.note: Reddit help center publishes no exact feed-post image dimensions. 1:1 (1080x1080) displays cleanly in-card; landscape 4:3 (1200x900) and 16:9 also accepted. px from standard — official number not published.

video.note: Reddit help center publishes no exact feed-video dimensions (only comment-video min 50x50). 16:9 (1280x720) is the standard horizontal upload. px from standard — official number not published.

image.note: Discord states the minimum icon size is 128x128; 512x512 is the recommended upload (px from standard), displayed masked to a circle. ratio 1:1 confirmed by official doc.

video.note: Server icon (still or animated) is 1:1; 512x512 recommended. px from standard, ratio from official doc.

image.note: Discord recommends server banners be at least 960x540 px in a 16:9 aspect ratio (1920x1080 also accepted and auto-resized). Exact px from official doc.

video.note: Animated server banners use the same 960x540 (16:9) recommendation. Exact px from official doc.

image.note: Threads reuses Instagram/Meta's upload pipeline (1.91:1 to 3:4 window, 1080px width); 4:5 portrait (1080x1350) is the recommended post format. px from standard, ratio from official Meta doc.

video.note: Threads video is 9:16 vertical (1080x1920 standard), consistent with Meta's Reels 1.91:1 to 9:16 guidance. px from standard, ratio from official Meta doc.
